title: HackRoad pocket expense playbook
body:
Purpose:
Quick pocket playbook for the multi-city HackRoad (mini roadshow) — receipts, petty cash, vendor on-call, SIM/wi‑fi, and fast reimbursements. This is my working list (notes-to-self) to hand to whoever covers ops while I’m on the road.

Trip summary (cities):
- Vienna (install) — 2 days, booth setup + evening meetup
- Amsterdam (workshop) — 1 day, full day workshop (50 attendees)
- Copenhagen (mini-demo) — 1 evening, partner dinner

Toplines / rules of thumb:
- Per diem: EUR 65/day (meals + incidental). Use corporate card for vendor invoices > 75 EUR.
- Keep physical receipts for any cash > 20 EUR (photo + Google Drive upload within 24h).
- All receipts go to expense-pipeline: scan -> small OCR -> upload to Drive folder -> tag in Expensify.
- If vendor accepts corporate card, add reference: "RW-HACKROAD-<city>-<date>" on charge memo.

Immediate TODOs before first flight:
- Confirm local vendor contacts (see vendor list below). Call each vendor 72h before arrival to reconfirm door time.
- Buy preloaded travel eSIM (T-Mobile EU Pass backup) and test VPN access with IT.
- Pack portable receipt scanner + spare phone charger and adapter kit.
- Create outfit/kit checklist for booth: HDMI->USB-C, power strip, cable ties, leftover swag box.

Receipts flow (fast path):
1) Snap photo with phone; add city tag in filename (e.g., AMS-2025-10-12-uber.jpg).
2) Quick OCR using phone app (ABBYY/Scanbot) — export text file with vendor, amount, VAT if present.
3) Upload photo + OCR txt to Drive folder: shared/users/expenses/hackroad/2025/AMS/
4) Add line in daily expense sheet (link in linked_artifacts).
5) Submit for mileage/reimbursement by end of week; expenses > 300 EUR require additional approval from finance (JIRA TRVL-842).

Vendor on-call list (primary / backup / notes):
- Vienna loading crew — Primary: "LoadRite Events" (Anna K.) tel: +43 1 234 5678; Backup: "FastLift" tel: +43 699 11 22 33. Note: bring extra gaffer tape and 3m ladder.
- Amsterdam AV — Primary: "EchoAV" (Mert) tel: +31 20 987 6543; Accepts corporate card but prefer invoice. Ask for flight-case dolly.
- Copenhagen caterer — Primary: "NordBites" (Sofie) tel: +45 33 44 55 66; vegetarian options required, confirm 48h before.

Emergency petty cash protocol:
- Keep a single envelope (EUR 200) for small incidentals per city. Track with simple ledger (photo of each withdrawal + receipt).
- If cash runs out, contact oncall: Diego Marquez (slack @diego) to push emergency pre-approval via procurement.

Corporate card fallback & limits:
- Primary card = events@redwood (assigned to Diego). If declined: call bank + ask for manual pre-auth message.
- Single transaction limit without pre-approval: EUR 1,500. Anything above needs finance pre-approval via JIRA.

Local telecom / VPN steps (short):
- Buy eSIM profile before departure (Airalo recommended). Keep T-Mobile EU pass as physical esim in case of app issues.
- If corporate VPN fails, use backup: WireGuard profile stored in 1Password (folder: Travel/Temp).
- Test by SSHing to staging inference cluster and fetching small artifact (~50KB) within hotel wifi.

Expense categories (use these exact categories in Expensify upload):
- TRANSPORT: flights, trains, taxis, rideshares
- LODGING: hotels, short-term stays
- MEALS: in-meeting food, per-diem reconciliation
- OPS: booth materials, shipping, hardware repairs
- VENDOR: contracted services (AV, loader, caterer) — add invoice number if available
- MISC: postage, currency fees, SIM cards

Notes on VAT & invoices (quick):
- EU VAT: ask for a VAT-inclusive invoice and capture vendor tax id (if > 300 EUR).
- For refunds, finance needs original VAT invoice PDF + OCR text.
- If vendor only gives receipt (no VAT #), tag as MISC and explain during submission.

Slack/Comm references:
- Create ephemeral channel for each city: #hackroad-vienna, #hackroad-ams, #hackroad-cph. Post photos of receipts in channel and pin.
- Use oncall channel for urgent vendor escalations (#events-oncall).

Unresolved questions / followups (flagged):
- Who is responsible for shipping leftover swag back to SF? (asked ops@ in Slack, awaiting reply).
- Confirm whether partner dinner in CPH covers vendor tip or if we handle separately.

Quick checklist for end of each day:
- Upload all receipts for that city and tag them with date and category.
- Capture 1 photo of booth status (left corner, right corner, attendee shot).
- Check petty cash tally and photograph remaining cash + ledger.
- Jot one line summary in Slack channel about any vendor issues.

Helpful links / artifacts (copy into Drive):
- Expense sheet template: CONFLUENCE: HW-TRAVEL-EXPENSE-TEMPLATE
- Vendor contract snippets (attach here) -> see linked_artifacts id: CONFLUENCE: HW-TRAVEL-PLAYBOOK

Final notes:
- This doc is a scratchpad. When done, convert to a short public-facing checklist (1 page) for the site team and upload to Confluence.
- If anyone is covering me: please follow the receipts flow strictly — finance rejects messy uploads.

Random notes-to-self (brain dump):
- Bring a ziploc for receipts, label by day.
- Ask engineering to pre-warm demo endpoint for each city (ticket TRVL-845).
- Remind Priya to bring extra plug adapters (2x EU->US).

---
End of scratchpad (Emily).
summary: Working pocket playbook for multi-city hackathon roadshow covering receipts, vendor contacts, petty cash, telecom/VPN backups, and daily ops checklist. Draft for handoff and conversion to Confluence checklist.
